moments.title: Amy Grant turns 66
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning Christian and pop singer-songwriter Amy Grant celebrates her 66th birthday on November 25th.

angles.name: Queen of Christian Pop
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the incredible Amy Grant! From Christian pop anthems to mainstream hits, her voice is timeless. What's your favourite Amy track?

angles.name: Heart in Motion
angles.copy: Celebrating Amy Grant's 66th birthday tomorrow! 'Heart in Motion' gave us 'Baby Baby' and so many feel-good tunes. Still sounds fresh today.

moments.title: Randy Newman turns 83
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter and film composer Randy Newman celebrates his 83rd birthday on November 28th.

angles.name: You've Got a Friend in Him
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Randy Newman! From 'Short People' to countless Pixar scores, his wry wit and unforgettable melodies have shaped generations. What's your top Newman moment?

angles.name: Film Score Maestro
angles.copy: He's the voice behind some of the most iconic movie songs! Wishing Randy Newman a very happy 83rd birthday on Saturday. Which of his film scores is your favourite?

moments.title: Billy Idol turns 71
moments.blurb: Punk rock icon Billy Idol celebrates his 71st birthday on November 30th.

angles.name: Rebel Yell
angles.copy: It's a 'Rebel Yell' for Billy Idol! Wishing the punk rock legend a very happy 71st birthday on Monday. What's your favourite track from the 'Prince of Punk'?

angles.name: White Wedding
angles.copy: He gave us 'White Wedding' and 'Dancing With Myself'. Billy Idol turns 71 on November 30th! Still bringing that classic rock energy.

moments.title: Cyber Monday 2026
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest online shopping event, Cyber Monday, takes place on November 30th, following Black Friday weekend.

angles.name: Online Shopping Frenzy
angles.copy: Cyber Monday is here! The UK's biggest online shopping day is November 30th. Are you hunting for deals or avoiding the digital crowds?

angles.name: Last Chance Deals
angles.copy: It's the grand finale of the sales weekend! Cyber Monday, November 30th, is your last chance for those Black Friday deals. What's on your wishlist?

moments.title: Bette Midler turns 81
moments.blurb: The Divine Miss M, Bette Midler, celebrates her 81st birthday on December 1st.

angles.name: The Divine Miss M
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the one and only Divine Miss M, Bette Midler! From Broadway to 'Beaches', her talent is legendary. What's your favourite Bette moment?

angles.name: Wind Beneath My Wings
angles.copy: She gave us 'Wind Beneath My Wings' and so many iconic performances. Happy 81st to Bette Midler on Tuesday! Still shining bright.

moments.title: Britney Spears turns 45
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Britney Spears celebrates her 45th birthday on December 2nd.

angles.name: Princess of Pop
angles.copy: It's Britney, b*tch! The Princess of Pop, Britney Spears, turns 45 on Wednesday. What's your all-time favourite Britney hit?

angles.name: Iconic Hits
angles.copy: From 'Baby One More Time' to 'Toxic', Britney Spears defined an era. Wishing her a very happy 45th birthday tomorrow!

moments.title: Nelly Furtado turns 48
moments.blurb: Canadian singer-songwriter Nelly Furtado celebrates her 48th birthday on December 2nd.

angles.name: I'm Like a Bird
angles.copy: Happy 48th birthday to the versatile Nelly Furtado! From 'I'm Like a Bird' to 'Maneater', her sound is unmistakable. What's your favourite Nelly track?

angles.name: Global Superstar
angles.copy: Celebrating Nelly Furtado's 48th birthday on December 2nd! The Grammy-winning artist has given us so many global hits.

moments.title: Jay-Z turns 57
moments.blurb: Hip-hop mogul and entrepreneur Jay-Z celebrates his 57th birthday on December 4th.

angles.name: Hova at 57
angles.copy: Happy 57th birthday to the one and only Jay-Z! From Marcy Projects to music mogul, his influence is undeniable. What's your favourite Hov track?

angles.name: Empire State of Mind
angles.copy: He's an artist, a businessman, a legend. Jay-Z turns 57 on Friday! Still inspiring millions with his 'Empire State of Mind'.

moments.title: Cardiff Christmas Market & Winter Wonderland
moments.blurb: Cardiff's city centre is buzzing with the Christmas Market (until Dec 23) and Winter Wonderland (until Jan 3, 2027), offering festive stalls, ice skating, and rides.

angles.name: Festive Fun in Cardiff
angles.copy: Cardiff is officially a winter wonderland! The Christmas Market is open daily until Dec 23rd, and the Winter Wonderland with ice rink and rides runs until Jan 3rd. Get down there!

angles.name: Shop Local, Skate Big
angles.copy: Support local makers at the Cardiff Christmas Market or hit the ice at Winter Wonderland! Plenty of festive cheer to be found in the capital this week.

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart Top 40 will be announced this Friday, November 27th, revealing the week's biggest hits.

angles.name: Chart Race
angles.copy: Who's battling for the top spot? The Official UK Singles Chart Top 40 is announced this Friday! Any predictions for the new number one?

angles.name: New Music Friday
angles.copy: Get ready for the latest hits! The new UK Singles Chart drops on Friday. What new tunes are you hoping to see climb the ranks?
